Tour FAQ

Good to know

All FAQs

Can two people ride on one jet ski?

↓

Yes. Each WaveRunner carries up to 2 riders or 400 lb total, and there are no passenger fees. Over the limit? We'll set you up with a second ski.

Do I need experience?

↓

No. Many of our guests have never ridden before. Every tour starts with a full orientation on the controls, steering and safety, and your guide leads the way the whole time.

Will we see dolphins?

↓

Wildlife is never guaranteed, but dolphin encounters are very common around Fort De Soto and Egmont Key. Our guides keep a respectful distance so the animals stay comfortable.

What happens if the weather turns?

↓

We monitor the marine forecast every day. If conditions are unsafe, you get a full refund or an easy reschedule.

Do I need a boating license?

↓

Anyone born on or after January 1, 1988 needs a Florida boater education card to operate a jet ski. You can get a temporary card online in minutes before your tour.

Pick your tour and time online, or call us and we'll help you choose.
